0.33.0: You can now store durable per-machine environment facts about yourself (project root, OS, tool choices) so teammates' sessions detect setup divergence -- ask Claude to remember an environment fact.
Facts are self-only to write, open to read, and always disclosed when stored; ask Claude to remove any of them at any time (one call forgets everything).
Your machines are tracked separately (hostname-keyed, capped at 10) -- facts live in small per-person files under .cognition/people/, committed like the journal.
0.31.0: Groundwork for fixing leaked server processes: the server now identifies its real client and logs stale siblings (report-only -- nothing is acted on, exit behavior is unchanged).
get_status now includes a machine-wide stale-server sweep so you can see leaked vibe_cognition processes at a glance.
0.32.0: Vector embeddings (chromadb) now live in the plugin's data dir, not inside your repo -- the .cognition/chromadb folder in your projects is no longer used and is SAFE TO DELETE.
Embeddings rebuild automatically at the new location the first time each project opens (one-time; larger graphs take a few minutes). Your journal and documents stay in the repo as before.
0.29.0: Session-start now checks once a day for a newer released plugin version and shows a one-line reminder if you're behind (disable with VIBE_UPDATE_NUDGE=off).
Nothing is installed automatically -- updating is always your call; the reminder just tells you the exact /plugin update command to run.
0.30.0: After an update, session-start shows a one-time summary of what's new since your last session (disable with VIBE_WHATS_NEW=off).
The summary is curated and short -- full details always live in CHANGELOG.md.
